Overall, Cherry Zashimi is a solid choice if you want a flavorful strain that gives you a happy, balanced high with a sweet twist. products.description: Click here for COA Jealousy strain is a well-balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) made by crossing two impressive strains: Gelato 41 and Sunset Sherbet. This earthy strain has exceptionally high THC levels, around 28-30%, and is perfect for experienced cannabis users. Jealousy THCa strain will bring an uplifting high that will relax you for hours. You’ll then feel creativity coming over you, energizing your brain with motivation to finish any task. On the comedown, you’ll feel a euphoric body high, leaving you happy and maybe giggly. Jealousy strain is a real standout for anyone who loves a potent, well-rounded high with a dash of luxury. This combo brings together the best traits of both parents, delivering a smooth and flavorful experience with a bit of an edge. Visually, Jealousy is striking. The buds are often dense and compact, covered in a thick layer of glistening trichomes that give them a frosty, almost diamond-like appearance. You’ll notice vibrant colors too, with shades of deep green, purple, and a touch of orange pistils that really pop. Aroma-wise, Jealousy is quite enticing. It has a rich, complex scent with strong notes of sweet, citrusy fruit, combined with hints of earthy and pine undertones. It’s like a fresh, fruity dessert with a touch of spice—inviting and intriguing. When it comes to flavor, Jealousy continues to impress. The taste is smooth and sweet, with a fruity, citrusy profile that might remind you of a sherbet or candy. There’s also a subtle earthy undertone that rounds out the flavor, making each puff delicious and satisfying. As for the effects, Jealousy delivers a balanced high that hits both your mind and body. You’ll start with an uplifting, euphoric buzz that boosts your mood and creativity, perfect for socializing or diving into creative projects. As the high progresses, you’ll experience a relaxing body effect that helps ease tension without making you too sleepy or couch-locked. Overall, Jealousy is a fantastic choice if you’re into strains that offer a rich flavor profile and a well-rounded high. It’s great for enhancing social experiences, winding down, or simply enjoying a flavorful smoke. If you’re looking for something that combines sweetness with a bit of sophistication, Jealousy is definitely worth a try! products.description: Click here for COA Tres Leches is a strain that’s definitely worth checking out if you’re into tasty and potent flower. It’s a hybrid, usually a cross between Tres Dawg and a few other strains, which gives it a unique profile. The name might give you a clue—it’s named after the rich, sweet dessert, and that’s exactly what you’re getting. The strain has a creamy, dessert-like flavor with hints of vanilla and a touch of earthy spice. It’s smooth and sweet, making each toke feel like a treat. As for the effects, Tres Leches offers a balanced high. It starts with a nice, euphoric uplift that can get you feeling chatty and happy, which is great for hanging out with friends or just enjoying some good vibes. As the high progresses, it transitions into a more relaxed, mellow feeling. It’s not going to leave you glued to the couch, but it will definitely help you unwind and kick back. In terms of its therapeutic effects, Tres Leches can be great for managing stress or anxiety. It can help with relaxation without completely knocking you out, so you can still stay productive if you need to. It also tends to spark up an appetite, so if you’ve got the munchies, this strain’s got you covered. Overall, Tres Leches is a solid pick if you’re looking for a flavorful strain with a balanced high that’s both uplifting and relaxing. Terpenes Myrcene: This is usually a prominent terpene in Tres Leches. It has an earthy, musky aroma with hints of fruit, and it's known for its relaxing and sedative effects. Myrcene helps to give the strain its mellow, calming qualities and enhances the overall relaxing high. It also adds a bit of that creamy, smooth flavor to the profile. Limonene: With its bright, citrusy scent, Limonene adds a zesty, lemon-like flavor to Tres Leches. This terpene is known for its mood-enhancing properties and can give you a bit of a mental boost. It contributes to the uplifting and euphoric part of the high, making it feel more enjoyable and energizing. Caryophyllene: This terpene brings a spicy, peppery aroma and flavor to the mix. It’s unique because it can interact with the body’s cannabinoid receptors, offering potential anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving benefits. Green Crack THCa Flower, often referred to by the less controversial name "Green Crush" or "Mango Crack," is a potent sativa-dominant hybrid strain born from the cross of Skunk #1 with an unknown indica. With a tangy, fruity flavor reminiscent of sweet mango, Green Crack is a daytime favorite for those looking to combat fatigue, stress, and low energy. Pinene: Adds a refreshing pine scent, which may help with alertness and memory, counterbalancing the sedative qualities of Myrcene. These terpenes work together to create Green Crack's distinctive aroma and are key to its energizing and mood-enhancing properties. This strain is beloved for its energizing effects that keep you focused and motivated throughout the day. With a tangy, fruity flavor reminiscent of sweet mango, Green Crack is a daytime favorite for those looking to combat fatigue, stress, and low energy. Green Crack Strain Terpenes The terpene profile of Green Crack significantly contributes to its sensory appeal and effects: Myrcene : The most abundant terpene, it imparts an earthy, musky aroma, potentially enhancing the strain's relaxing yet uplifting effects. Caryophyllene: Offers a spicy, peppery note, enriching the flavor profile while possibly providing anti-inflammatory benefits. Pinene: Adds a refreshing pine scent, which may help with alertness and memory, counterbalancing the sedative qualities of Myrcene. These terpenes work together to create Green Crack's distinctive aroma and are key to its energizing and mood-enhancing properties. The strain's effects are cerebral, promoting a sense of well-being, creativity, and motivation, making it a go-to for those battling lethargy or mental fog. products.description: Strain Profile Bath Saltz THCA Flower is a hybrid that crosses Bubble Bath (The Soap × Project 4516) with Runtz (Zkittlez × Gelato). The genetics stack is essentially a greatest-hits of modern dessert lineage — and it shows in the bag: frosty, dense, candy-sweet flower with a clean structure and loud aromatic profile. Effects Bath Saltz tilts toward uplifted hybrid. Expect a euphoric, mood-lifting onset that settles into a comfortably focused baseline — the kind of high that improves your afternoon without taking it over. Long-lasting and steady, with enough cerebral energy for creative work and enough body ease to keep you out of your head. A versatile all-day pick. Flavor & Aroma On the nose: sugary candy and ripe fruit up front, with creamy vanilla layered underneath and a subtle earthy-pine note grounding the finish. Smoke is smooth, dessert-rich, and unmistakably Runtz-family in its terpene loudness. The flavor profile leans tropical-creamy — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Bath Saltz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. View the Bath Saltz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Bath Saltz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Blue Zushi THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cross brings the colorful, fruit-forward bag appeal Zkittlez is famous for and pairs it with the cool, earthy depth of Kush Mints — producing buds with deep purple-blue expression and a layered terpene profile dominated by limonene and caryophyllene . Effects Blue Zushi delivers a balanced euphoric experience that settles into a comfortable, body-relaxing baseline. The high feels mood-lifting without being racy, and physically calming without being sedating — making it a popular pick among users seeking steady stress relief or a reliable evening unwind. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe blueberry and tropical fruit up front, with a cool minty middle and a sweet, slightly creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and dessert-leaning. The terpene profile is limonene-forward with a peppery caryophyllene backbone — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Zushi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Zushi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Zushi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Blue Zushi THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cross brings the colorful, fruit-forward bag appeal Zkittlez is famous for and pairs it with the cool, earthy depth of Kush Mints — producing buds with deep purple-blue expression and a layered terpene profile dominated by limonene and caryophyllene . Effects Blue Zushi delivers a balanced euphoric experience that settles into a comfortable, body-relaxing baseline. The high feels mood-lifting without being racy, and physically calming without being sedating — making it a popular pick among users seeking steady stress relief or a reliable evening unwind. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe blueberry and tropical fruit up front, with a cool minty middle and a sweet, slightly creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and dessert-leaning. The terpene profile is limonene-forward with a peppery caryophyllene backbone — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Zushi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Zushi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Zushi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. THCA: 20.004% Delta-9 THC: 0.281% Blueberry Fruit hybrid Tropical Fruit THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.name: Blue Zushi THCA Flower Supreme / 28g

products.description: Strain Profile BOLO Runtz THCA Flower is an indica-dominant hybrid bred from Biscotti crossed with Sherb Cake . The cross delivers a uniquely contrasting flavor profile that blends sweet dessert character with savory backbone — producing dense, structurally premium buds with deep color expression and serious bag appeal. Effects BOLO Runtz delivers a comfortable, indica-leaning experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with relaxing body effects. The high lands steadily and lasts — suitable for late-afternoon use, evening unwinding, or any moment where flavor character paired with real depth is the appeal. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet biscotti-cookie up front, with savory undertones through the middle and a creamy cake finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably contrasting. The terpene profile reads sweet-and-savory-cream — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every BOLO Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the BOLO Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms BOLO Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Carbon Fiber THCA Flower is a three-way hybrid bred from Grape Pie , Biscotti , and Cookies and Cream . The result is a structurally premium bud: dense, dark, glassy with trichomes, and visually closer to a top-shelf cookie cut than a typical fruit hybrid. A potent profile geared toward experienced users who want depth without blowing past their tolerance. Effects Carbon Fiber lands on the heavier end of hybrid. The onset is fast and noticeably cerebral — thoughtful, slightly introspective — before settling into a deeply relaxed body baseline. Best paired with downtime, a meal, or a quiet evening rather than tasks that require sharp focus. A classic experienced-smoker hybrid. Flavor & Aroma Layered and complex on the palate: earthy and slightly peppery up front, with sweet ripe berries from the Grape Pie parent and a baked, creamy Biscotti backbone on the exhale. Smoke carries a subtle chemical edge that pulls everything together. The terpene profile reads dessert-meets-gas — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. products.description: Strain Profile Gush Mintz THCA Flower is a potent indica-dominant hybrid developed by Purple City Genetics in the Bay Area, crossing Kush Mints with F1 Durb and Gushers. The lineage stack delivers compact, deep-green and purple buds with generous trichome coverage and the pungent, sweet-pine aromatic profile that distinguishes this cultivar from typical mint hybrids. Effects Gush Mintz delivers a deeply relaxing experience anchored by full-body ease and warm cerebral euphoria. Onset is steady and the high lasts — suitable for evening use, post-work decompression, or any moment that benefits from real wind-down. A cultivar that earns its top-shelf reputation among indica fans. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: pungent sweetness up front, with cool minty pine through the middle and a grounding earthy finish on the exhale. Smoke is full, layered, and richly textured. The terpene profile reads mint-and-pine with sweet depth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Gush Mintz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Gush Mintz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Gush Mintz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. The cross delivers a richly dessert-leaning aromatic profile and dense, well-structured buds with deep color expression and generous trichome coverage — a connoisseur-leaning cultivar with broad flavor appeal. Effects Jealousy delivers a euphoric yet deeply relaxing experience. The cerebral side stays mood-lifting and pleasant; the body baseline settles into calm, easy relaxation rather than heavy sedation. A versatile cultivar for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening unwinding without committing to a couch-locked night. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet creamy notes up front, with bright citrus through the middle and a warm earthy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably dessert-rich. The terpene profile reads cream-citrus-and-earth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Jealousy harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Jealousy THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Jealousy THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. THCA: 24.358% Delta-9 THC: 0.2207% Citrus Cream hybrid Sweet THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Lemon OG THCA Flower is an indica-dominant hybrid (60/40) expressing 17–24% THC with prominent limonene and myrcene concentrations, delivering classic OG genetics with citrus enhancement. This cultivar produces dense, lime-green buds with heavy trichome coverage and bright orange pistils. Effects Effects begin with uplifting cerebral euphoria and mental clarity before settling into relaxing body sedation typical of OG lineage. Lemon OG's balanced effects make it versatile for evening relaxation or daytime use in moderate doses, with therapeutic applications including stress reduction, pain relief, and appetite stimulation. Flavor & Aroma The flavor profile combines sharp lemon zest with earthy, fuel-like undertones and subtle pine notes, creating the signature OG taste with citrus brightness. products.description: Strain Profile Motor OG THCA Flower is a potent indica-dominant hybrid that combines the heavy fuel notes of Motorbreath with the earthy classic depth of OG Kush . The cultivar produces dense, dark-toned buds with a bold pungent aromatic profile filled with sharp diesel, earthy pine, and a touch of herbal spice. Effects Motor OG delivers a robust, indica-leaning experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with deep body relaxation. The high lands fast and lasts — suitable for evening use, post-work decompression, or settling in with flavor character intact. A high-tolerance OG-line cultivar. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: gassy diesel up front, with skunky pine through the middle and a warm herbal-spice finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably gas-rich. The terpene profile reads diesel-and-pine — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Motor OG harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Motor OG THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Motor OG THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. THCA: 25.735% Delta-9 THC: 0.1942% Gas indica Pine Skunk THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Petrol Pie THCA Flower is a hybrid bred from Jet Fuel crossed with Wedding Pie . The cross marries the electric, gas-forward aromatic backbone of Jet Fuel with the irresistible dessert sweetness of Wedding Pie — producing dense buds with serious bag appeal and a flavor profile that genuinely uses both halves of its genetic stack. Effects Petrol Pie delivers a harmonious balance of energizing onset and smooth descent into relaxation. The high feels engaging up front — good for users who want a thrill component — before settling into a comfortable, body-easy baseline. A versatile cultivar for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening unwinding. Flavor & Aroma On the nose: pungent jet fuel up front, with sweet pastry-cake through the middle and a warm dessert-meets-gas finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and assertively flavored. The terpene profile reads gas-and-bakery — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Petrol Pie harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Petrol Pie THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Petrol Pie THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Sugar Tab THCA Flower is a hybrid developed by Grandiflora Genetics , bred from LEDX8 crossed with LCG Grandi Candi #8 . The lineage suggests a sweet, candy-leaning aromatic profile, paired with the dense bud structure and high-end appearance Grandiflora cultivars are known for. Effects Sugar Tab delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral lift with a comfortable body baseline. The high feels well-rounded and steady — suitable for daytime social use, late-afternoon decompression, or evening unwinding without leaning hard in either direction. A versatile, flavor-led hybrid. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet candy-sugar up front, with a layered fruit middle and a clean, dessert-leaning finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and refreshingly bright. The terpene profile reads sweet-candy with fruit accents — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Sugar Tab harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Sugar Tab THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Sugar Tab THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. THCA: 26.678% Delta-9 THC: 0.1801% Candy Dessert Fruit hybrid THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Zushi THCA Flower is a unique hybrid bred from the flavorful combination of Zkittlez and Kush Mints . The cultivar captures attention with vibrant candy sweetness accented by refreshing minty notes, subtle earthiness, and delicate citrus undertones — producing dense, colorful buds with the kind of bag appeal that telegraphs flavor character. Effects Zushi delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of refreshing character that distinguishes this Zkittlez-mints cross. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: vibrant candy sweetness up front, with cool minty notes through the middle and a subtle earthy-citrus finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably refreshing. The terpene profile reads candy-mint-and-citrus — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Zushi harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Zushi THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Zushi THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Lolliato Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Southern Oregon Private Farm The same Southern Oregon farm responsible for the Toad Venom phenotypes that earned Herb.co’s 2026 THCa Flower Strain of the Year developed Lolliato as a separate genetic direction entirely. Where Confetti Venom takes the Toad Venom foundation and adds dimension, Lolliato is the farm pursuing a different question: what does candy-forward Gelato-family genetics look like when the farm selects specifically for lollipop-candy character and grows it in a no-till living soil environment that amplifies terpene expression at every development stage? The name answers the question directly. Lolliato is the portmanteau of lollipop and Gelato — the specific candy format that is purely sweet, purely bright, and comes in colors that are themselves the flavor indicators. Gelato genetics, developed by the Cookies Fam collective from Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint GSC, already carry the caryophyllene-limonene-linalool terpene combination that produces the creamy, sweet, dessert character the Gelato family is known for. The lollipop parent adds the bright, singular candy-sweet dimension that pushes the profile from dessert-rich toward something more immediately striking — the candy you find at the bottom of a bag that is somehow more intensely flavored than anything else in it. In living soil from the Southern Oregon farm, both the Gelato creamy depth and the lollipop candy brightness develop at full concentration. The linalool from the Gelato genetics — the floral-lavender compound that gives Gelato-family strains their smooth, rounded sweetness — accumulates more completely in the mycorrhizal root zone. The result is a terpene profile that is sweet-bright on top and creamy-dessert underneath, the candy and the cream running simultaneously rather than one following the other. This farm does not release strains it is not proud of. Lolliato is on the shelf because the Southern Oregon program earned it. Lolliato Strain Genetics Gelato-family x Lollipop-candy parent | Southern Oregon Private Farm — In-House Breeding Program | Hybrid The Gelato-family parent, descended from Sunset Sherbet x

Street Tarts Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Purple City Genetics built Street Tarts from Guava Tart and Street Guru, and the cross landed in a specific territory between tropical fruit candy and gas-forward pastry that most strains named after confectionery never actually reach. Guava Tart brings the guava funk and tropical tartness. Street Guru brings the street-level gas depth and the urban edge that the name implies. Together they produce something that is genuinely tart in the way fruit candy is tart rather than the way generic “candy” strains approximate it — the citrus and tropical notes have an actual sour bite before the sweetness resolves. The visual is what consumers consistently mention first. Glittering purple buds drenched in resinous trichomes, with a trichome architecture dense enough to reflect light. The purple coloration develops from the genetics rather than temperature stress — it is an expression of the anthocyanin compounds in the Guava Tart genetics rather than a manipulation of the environment to force color. That distinction matters in living soil cultivation: the color is the plant’s own response to the genetics under conditions that support full secondary metabolite expression. The terpene profile runs tropical, gas, and pastry simultaneously — a nose that opens with guava and tropical citrus tartness, then shifts to the Street Guru gas depth, then settles on something warm and slightly doughy underneath. That progression is what earns the “tarts” reference: a candy that opens sweet-tart and resolves to something with body. Indica-leaning hybrid. Cerebral euphoria arriving first, body weight building. This is from our private Northern California small-batch program — limited quantity, grown in living soil, not a rotating catalog item. Blue Razz Eclair Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Two distinct flavor references compressed into one strain name. Blue Razz is the sharp, tart blue raspberry candy note — the candy color that is not actually a real fruit but has become one of the most immediately recognizable flavor identities in American confectionery. An eclair is a pastry: choux dough exterior, cream filling, chocolate glaze. The combination in a strain name is doing something specific. Not “Blue Razz” with sweetness behind it. Blue Razz with a cream-filled pastry depth behind it. The tartness is the front. The eclair is what you find underneath. The Blue Razz family traces through Blue Cookies and Mendobreath UV and through Raspberry Kush-adjacent genetics to a Blueberry-descended foundation that gives the blue family its characteristic dark berry and blueberry depth. The specific Blue Razz Eclair expression adds the pastry and cream character to that foundation — a Cookies or Gelato-adjacent cross adding the doughy-sweet depth that turns a sharp berry candy profile into a dessert experience with layers. Berry above cream above dough. The specific tart sour note that makes blue raspberry candy immediately recognizable, resolved by a cream-filled finish. Indica-leaning hybrid. The berry brightness of the Blue Razz lineage delivers the initial mood elevation while the eclair-adjacent pastry genetics ground it in a settled, comfortable body experience. Not a racy sativa despite the bright candy opening. The opening is the sour blue raspberry hit. What it resolves into is the full eclair. From our private Northern California small-batch farm. Living soil. Limited quantity. All Hemp products have a matching COA on the product page so you can see potency and compliance. Afghani Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Ramiya ordered at night. It arrived the next morning. She tried it and wrote: “Honestly one of the best strains I’ve ever had. The flavor is earthy, the smoke was clean, and the effects were exactly what I wanted (sleepy, relaxed, euphoric). Definitely sticking to this landrace strain. I’ve tried many THCa flowers, this has gotta be the freshest and most potent medicine I’ve had.” She is only buying from Sherlocks now. That is both a store endorsement and a strain review from someone who has tried enough THCa flower to have a reference point worth trusting. Afghani is the same pure Hindu Kush landrace that appears in the Afghani Living Soil Exotic AAA — the genetics that built the Western cannabis industry, the pure indica that appears in the lineage of OG Kush, Blueberry, Northern Lights, and virtually every major hybrid in the last forty years. This is the Indoor Special version. Same genetics, controlled indoor environment, a different price point for buyers who want the Afghani experience without the AAA premium. What indoor cultivation provides for Afghani specifically is humidity management. Pure indica landraces with the compact, dense bud structure that Hindu Kush genetics produce are susceptible to moisture retention in variable humidity environments — the density that makes the visual so striking is also what makes precise drying and curing essential. Indoor precision keeps the moisture gradient consistent from the surface of the bud to the core, which is what produces the clean smoke that Ramiya specifically noted. Harsh smoke in indica-dominant flower almost always traces back to improper drying or residual moisture in dense bud structure. This does not have that problem. The earthy hash character that Ramiya described as exactly what she wanted is the myrcene and caryophyllene combination in Afghani genetics — the same compounds that produce the classic hash aroma the original plant was cultivated for in the Hindu Kush mountains. Deep, spiced earth with pine and a subtle herbal warmth. The freshness she noticed is the terpene integrity that proper indoor drying and curing preserves. The pot

Birthday Cake Strain THCa Flower – Light Assist Private SoCal Farm Birthday Cake originated at Kind Love dispensary in Denver in 2014 under the name Pink Cookies before arriving in Colorado with its current name. Cannarado Genetics popularized it as Birthday Cake S1 — a cross between two crosses, GSC x Cherry Pie run back against itself, stacking the dessert character from both parents at twice the concentration. The genetics are a direct ancestor of Wedding Cake and the entire dessert-Cookies lineage that defines the current premium hybrid market. This is the strain that the more famous cousins came from. The flavor profile lives up to the name in a specific rather than approximate way. The caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool terpene combination that Cherry Pie and GSC together produce creates a nose of sweet vanilla cake and creamy frosting — the specific frosting quality that linalool’s floral warmth adds to the caryophyllene’s spiced depth, sitting above the limonene citrus brightness that keeps the dessert profile from being purely heavy. It tastes like birthday cake the food rather than birthday cake the concept, which is rarer than it sounds in a market full of dessert-named strains that deliver generic sweetness. The effects follow the same structure as the genetics: the GSC side produces the immediate euphoric mood uplift and the social ease, the Cherry Pie side grounds it in a settled indica body ease that builds through the session toward deep physical relaxation. The opening is celebratory. The finish is comfortable. The indica 60/40 lean means this session ends on the couch rather than at the party, which is the appropriate arc for a strain named after the best part of the party. Birthday Cake Strain THCa Flower – Light Assist Private SoCal Farm Birthday Cake originated at Kind Love dispensary in Denver in 2014 under the name Pink Cookies before arriving in Colorado with its current name. Cannarado Genetics popularized it as Birthday Cake S1 — a cross between two crosses, GSC x Cherry Pie run back against itself, stacking the dessert character from both parents at twice the concentration. The genetics are a direct ancestor of Wedding Cake and the entire dessert-Cookies lineage that defines the current premium hybrid market. This is the strain that the more famous cousins came from. The flavor profile lives up to the name in a specific rather than approximate way. The caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool terpene combination that Cherry Pie and GSC together produce creates a nose of sweet vanilla cake and creamy frosting — the specific frosting quality that linalool’s floral warmth adds to the caryophyllene’s spiced depth, sitting above the limonene citrus brightness that keeps the dessert profile from being purely heavy. It tastes like birthday cake the food rather than birthday cake the concept, which is rarer than it sounds in a market full of dessert-named strains that deliver generic sweetness. The effects follow the same structure as the genetics: the GSC side produces the immediate euphoric mood uplift and the social ease, the Cherry Pie side grounds it in a settled indica body ease that builds through the session toward deep physical relaxation. The opening is celebratory. The finish is comfortable. The indica 60/40 lean means this session ends on the couch rather than at the party, which is the appropriate arc for a strain named after the best part of the party. Blue Dream Strain THCa Flower – Indoor Private Southern California Farm Blue Dream does not need an origin story at this point. The Blueberry x Haze cross from Santa Cruz is the most recognized sativa-dominant hybrid in American cannabis history — the strain that turned the California market toward fruit-forward sativa genetics in the mid-2000s and that has remained one of the most searched, most purchased, and most requested genetics in every legal market it has entered since. If you have been smoking cannabis long enough to have a reference point for what a sativa should feel like, Blue Dream is probably in that reference. The question is not what Blue Dream is. The question is where it comes from and how it was grown. DJ Short’s Blueberry — itself the Afghani x Purple Thai x Highland Thai cross that the cannabis community has considered one of the most important indica genetics since its release — contributes the blueberry sweetness and the indica body ease that prevents Blue Dream from being purely cerebral. The Haze parent contributes the sharp sativa energy, the creative uplift, and the citrus brightness that defines the sativa experience when Haze genetics are grown and expressed correctly. In indoor cultivation at our private Southern California farm, both contributions are present rather than one dominating. The blueberry sweetness is specific — DJ Short’s Blueberry genetics produce a more vivid and specific berry character than most Blueberry-named genetics available online because the lineage is documented and the cultivation environment supports full terpene expression. The Haze sativa energy is the functional, creative, clear-headed lift that made Blue Dream the go-to daytime strain for a decade before the exotic genetics market arrived and that still makes it the correct answer when someone specifically wants a classic California sativa experience rather than the newest candy cross. This is the Indoor tier — quality California indoor cultivation rather than the living soil AAA program. Blue Nerds Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Blue Nerds is one of those strains that creates a problem for the people selling it. The visual is so immediately arresting — deep grape-shaped buds, purple and blue coloration running through dense forest green, trichomes so thick they catch light from across a room — that the first thing every customer does is reach for the jar. The second thing they do is smell it and realize the visual wasn’t even the point. Sweet blueberry candy opens immediately. Tart citrus builds underneath. Then Granny Smith apple arrives — sharp and bright and not at all what the name prepared you for — and suddenly you understand why Global Genetics LA introduced this at Spannabis 2024 to the response it received. This is a candy terpene profile built on Runtz and Zkittlez genetics, which means the sweetness has depth rather than just surface. It doesn’t smell like a candy aisle. It smells like the specific piece of candy you remember eating as a child that you’ve been trying to find again ever since. The living soil cultivation is doing specific work here that is worth understanding. Blue Nerds carries a strong tendency toward purple and blue anthocyanin expression, and anthocyanin development responds to temperature cycling in ways that living soil cultivation naturally facilitates. A living soil bed — because of the thermal mass of its organic matter and microbiology — holds temperature more consistently than synthetic media but produces more natural day-to-night temperature variation than controlled indoor environments. That variation is what triggers the deepest purple expression in this genetics. The Blue Nerds in a living soil bed purple more completely and more evenly across the canopy than the same genetics in coco or rockwool. The visual that makes people reach for the jar is not incidental. It is what living soil does to this plant specifically. Cereal Milk Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Kam T put it plainly: the cereal n milk is one of her favorites. Nice body and head high, not too strong, just right. Sweet aroma. Pleasant taste. Not too harsh. She will definitely purchase again. That review is the brief. Cereal Milk is not a strain for the consumer who wants the most intense experience in the catalog. It is the strain for the consumer who wants something that delivers on its description precisely and without demanding anything complicated in return. The name is accurate in the way that the best strain names are accurate — not a loose reference to a general flavor category but the specific sensory experience of the sweetened milk left in the bowl after the cereal is gone. Slightly sweet. Slightly creamy. Slightly artificial in the specific way that breakfast cereal sweetness is slightly artificial. Not vanilla. Not just cream. The combination that exists in that specific context and nowhere else. Cookies Fam developed Cereal Milk from Sour Dubb and Y-Life — a Girl Scout Cookies phenotype that brought the creamy dough depth, and a Sour Diesel-adjacent cross that contributed the subtle diesel funk running under the sweetness. The combination is what prevents the cereal milk character from being purely sweet — there is a savory diesel undertone at the base that makes the cream note read as complex rather than just pleasant. The pale lime green buds with lavender hues and vivid orange pistils are the Cookies-family visual that this genetics reliably produces. Read the full cereal milk strain guide The light assist cultivation is the right environment for Cereal Milk’s terpene profile specifically because the linalool and myrcene combination that produces the creamy sweetness responds better to variable light exposure than to flat artificial spectrum. The creamy note in Cereal Milk — the specific character Kam T described as pleasant and not harsh — develops more completely under the natural spectrum variation of greenhouse cultivation. Indoor-only Cereal Milk tends to read as sweet and one-dimensional. The greenhouse version has the cream and the subtle diesel depth present simultaneous

Double Stuffed Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Exotic Genetix named this one after the Oreo filling and delivered on the reference more directly than most dessert strains manage. Platinum White x Cookies and Cream produces a terpene profile where vanilla, coffee, and cream arrive together rather than one at a time — the specific combination that Oreo Double Stuff delivers when you eat it before you see it. Not just sweet. Not just creamy. The layered thing. Platinum White, itself a cross of Platinum Kush and The White, contributes the extreme trichome production architecture — The White’s trichome amplification genetics working on the Platinum Kush’s potency foundation to produce the dense crystal coating that makes Platinum White-lineage strains visually distinctive. The White has almost no terpene profile of its own, which means it amplifies whatever the other parent is doing rather than competing with it. What it amplifies here is the Cookies and Cream contribution. Cookies and Cream, a Starfighter x GSC cross from Exotic Genetix, contributes the vanilla and cream depth, the sweet earthy dough note, the dense compact bud structure, and the deeply relaxing indica body ease that makes the 70/30 indica classification accurate in effect rather than just on paper. The coffee note — the slight bitter dark roast that runs under the vanilla and cream — comes from the Starfighter genetics, which carry a specific myrcene and caryophyllene combination that reads as earthy coffee rather than just generic earthiness. The indoor cultivation is what keeps the vanilla and coffee terpene expression intact through the post-harvest process. Both compounds — the linalool that produces the vanilla sweetness and the myrcene-caryophyllene combination that produces the coffee depth — are sensitive to temperature variation in the drying room. Precise indoor humidity management from harvest through cure preserves both simultaneously, which is why the Double Stuffed name holds up when you open the jar rather than just describing what the breeder was reaching toward. That is not exaggeration — the aroma on Gas Mask penetrates the seal in a way that most strains do not manage, and it is the first thing that tells you what this batch actually is before you confirm it by opening the container. Heavy fuel, skunk, and earthy pine hitting simultaneously, then the sweet cherry from the Cherry Pie genetics arriving underneath as the air settles. The name is accurate. If you have ever put on an actual gas mask and understood what the filter is meant to block out, the reference makes complete sense. Cherry Pie x Fire Alien Kush is the lineage and the combination is less obvious than it sounds. Cherry Pie — the Granddaddy Purple x F1 Durban Poison cross from the Bay Area — is known for its sweet cherry-and-berry dessert character, its purple and dark coloration, and the relaxing euphoric hybrid effect that made it a dispensary staple for years. Fire Alien Kush, bred from Fire OG and Alien Kush, is pure gas — heavy citrus fuel from the Fire OG lineage and the earthy, deeply sedative character that Alien Kush contributes from its Hindu Kush landrace roots. Crossing a dessert strain with a gas strain and getting Gas Mask as the result is not the obvious outcome. Most crosses in that direction produce something that smells either sweet-with-gas or gas-with-sweet-underneath. Gas Mask produces something where the cherry sweetness is present but the gas is so dominant that the dessert note reads as a finish rather than a feature. Check out the full Gas Mask strain writeup Scotty’s “guaranteed trip to the moon no matter what you select” is the right framing for this strain specifically. Kenneth H was skeptical first and not anymore. Isaac M would most definitely recommend. Camari H called it a five-star shop. These four reviews describe Sherlocks as a store rather than Gas Mask as a strain, which is the context worth having before you decide on this particular product — the store that put this batch on the shelf held it to the same standard as everything else you have read about on this site. Lemon Custard is the version that holds both simultaneously rather than sacrificing one for the other — the custard character, the warm egg-and-vanilla depth that actual custard produces, sitting beneath a bright lemon peel top note that remains specific and vivid rather than fading into generic citrus. Lemon Custard’s lineage traces to a Lemon Tree or Lemon Skunk-adjacent parent crossed with a Cookies-family or Gelato-family dessert contributor — the specific pairing that multiple breeders have converged on independently because it is the combination most likely to produce the custard character rather than just lemon-sweet or just creamy-dessert. The Lemon Tree heritage carries a specific limonene-plus-myrcene combination that produces the bright-and-grounded citrus quality — not sharp and clean like pure limonene, but warm and slightly earthy in a way that reads as the lemon in a baked custard rather than fresh-squeezed juice. The Cookies or Gelato contribution adds the vanilla and cream base that the custard name requires. What makes Lemon Custard worth growing in living soil specifically is the myrcene component. The citrus is present in any cultivation environment. The custard warmth that justifies the name is what the living soil is producing. Maui Wowie Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Michael got his order in about five days, tried the Maui Wowie alongside the White Widow, and was not let down compared to other vendors he had tried online. That review matters specifically because Michael named the strain — he was not reviewing the store in general or a different product, he was reviewing Maui Wowie specifically and decided it delivered. Maui Wowie has been in circulation since the 1970s. Hawaiian sativa landrace genetics, developed on the islands before most of the American cannabis market existed, selected over decades for the specific tropical fruit and citrus terpene profile and the clear, energetic, altitude-friendly high that became one of the most widely referenced cannabis experiences in the country. It has been imitated, diluted, and misrepresented on menus more than almost any other classic sativa. When it is the real genetics and it is grown correctly, the pineapple and mango note is specific and immediate — not tropical-adjacent, not citrus-forward with fruit described as tropical, but the actual Hawaiian sativa character that the original cultivars produced. Stephanie tried this batch and described a light fresh tropical smell and taste, then a hit of candy, then mint — ending in what she called eventual nirvana via a progression through calm, giggles, deep peace, and sustained tranquility throughout the body. That three-note terpene progression from tropical to candy to mint is the terpinolene expression from the Hawaiian genetics doing exactly what it evolved to do when it is given the cultivation conditions to develop fully. The light assist greenhouse is the correct environment for Maui Wowie for a reason that goes beyond the general light-assist-for-sativa explanation. Hawaiian landrace genetics evolved at altitude in the tropics — high UV exposure, warm days, cool nights, the full solar spectrum without moderation. These genetics do not respond to artificial-only spectrum the way continental sativa genetics do. They were bred for sun and they perform best when sun is part of the equation. The UV component of the greenhouse environment triggers terpinolene and ocime

Pineapple Express Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Seth Rogen and James Franco made Pineapple Express a household name in 2008. Before the film, it was a well-regarded sativa-dominant hybrid grown primarily in Hawaii and California. After the film, every cannabis operation in the country had something on the menu called Pineapple Express, and most of it had no meaningful relationship to the actual Trainwreck x Hawaiian genetics that produced the original. Carlo R called it a classic that stays in the test of time. He is right, and the cultural moment the film created is part of why — but the genetics are the deeper reason. Trainwreck x Hawaiian is a cross of two sativa-dominant genetics with genuinely complementary terpene profiles. Trainwreck, the Humboldt County three-way of Mexican Sativa, Thai Sativa, and Afghani Indica, brings the fast-acting cerebral energy, the spice and earthy lemon-lime depth, and the structural foundation. Hawaiian landrace genetics — the same source material that gave Maui Wowie its reputation — bring the tropical pineapple and citrus sweetness, the long-lasting uplifting sativa effect, and the specific Hawaiian terroir terpene expression that makes tropical fruit cannabis strains smell like actual tropical fruit rather than candy approximations. The combination produces the strain that the film was named after: sweet tropical pineapple on top, earthy spice from the Trainwreck depth underneath, a long-lasting energetic and creative high that made it the strain two people in a film about friendship and weed would chase across Los Angeles. The film made the name famous. The genetics made it worth keeping famous. Living soil is doing something specific with the Hawaiian landrace genetics in this cross. Hawaiian sativa genetics evolved outdoors with real UV exposure and complex soil biology — the same conditions that Maui Wowie requires and that we have discussed across every Hawaiian-lineage strain in the program. The pineapple and tropical fruit character in Hawaiian genetics responds to soil microbiology in ways that synthetic nutrient programs consistently underachieve. The living soil cultivation amplifies

Strawberry Cough Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Kyle Kushman developed Strawberry Cough from a Strawberry Fields cutting he received from a grower in Connecticut in 2000, crossed with an unknown Haze. The story goes that the first time he smoked it, the strawberry sweetness hit so intensely that it made him cough before he even exhaled. The name came from that experience rather than from marketing. The name has held up for twenty-five years because the experience it describes is real and consistent across grows when the genetics are handled correctly. Strawberry Cough actually smells and tastes like fresh strawberries — not strawberry candy, not strawberry-adjacent fruit, but the specific fresh-picked berry character that Kushman’s Strawberry Fields genetic contribution produces in the cross. The Haze genetics add the cerebral energy, the slight spice on the exhale, and the expansive sativa effect profile that prevented Strawberry Cough from being a novelty strain and made it a lasting one. The cough is the Haze expansion in the lungs meeting the sweet strawberry terpene intensity. Both are real. Both are the strain. The indoor cultivation is the appropriate environment for Strawberry Cough specifically because the strawberry terpene character — the limonene and ocimene combination that produces the fresh berry quality — is among the most volatile in the cannabis library. Indoor temperature precision from harvest through cure is what keeps the fresh strawberry note in the jar rather than allowing it to off-gas during a variable post-harvest process. The sweetness that makes this strain immediately recognizable requires careful handling to survive from harvest to consumption. John M found Strawberry Cough on the Sherlocks menu alongside Panama Red, Purple Haze, and Durban Poison. He noted he cannot wait to try the rest of the list. He has been waiting for places that keep old school genetics alive. Strawberry Cough is a different vintage from the landrace strains on that list but it represents the same commitment — a strain worth growing because it delivers something specific and genuine, not because it is commercially convenient. products.description: Must be 21+ to purchase. All Hemp Products sold at Sherlocks are federally compliant having less than .3% Delta 9 THC. All Hemp products have a matching COA on the product page so you can see potency and compliance. Super Runtz Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Gelato 33 x Zkittlez is the cross. Gelato 33 — the Bay Area selection from Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC that Sherbinski developed into one of the most imitated genetics of the last decade — brings the creamy ice cream sweetness, the dense trichome architecture, the euphoric balanced body ease, and the vanilla and cream depth that grounds the experience. Zkittlez, from 3rd Gen Family and Terp Hogz, brings the tropical candy fruit, the multi-layer brightness, and the uplifting social energy that keeps the Gelato 33 indica character from being purely sedative. The Super designation is what breeders use when a specific phenotype expresses both parent contributions at unusual intensity simultaneously — more fruit than standard Runtz, more cream than standard Zkittlez, the combination amplified rather than averaged. Jesse T found Sherlocks in a THCa Google search and the bag was loud when he popped it open. The smell was not muted like some internet THCa flower. That observation — loud, not muted — is the specific thing that the Indoor Special tier exists to deliver and the specific thing that this cross produces when the cultivation and post-harvest protocol are done correctly. The Indoor Special cultivation is the right environment for Super Runtz because Gelato 33 x Zkittlez genetics require temperature precision that outdoor and greenhouse cultivation cannot consistently provide. The vanilla and cream character from the Gelato 33 side is produced by a linalool and myrcene combination that stabilizes most completely under controlled temperatures during both flowering and cure. The tropical fruit brightness from the Zkittlez side requires the same limonene preservation that every citrus-adjacent terpene profile requires — controlled drying, low temperature, slow stabilization. Indoor cultivation handles both simultaneously. What Jesse T found loud in the bag is the result of that temperature management applied to genetics that specifically reward it. The grower on this batch noted that the Super phenotype in this genetics expresses its maximum terpene intensity only when harvested at the very top of

The grower who supplies this run has been phenotype hunting in the Trop Cherry genetics specifically for dark-fruit expression for two seasons.
